description.overview: Join us as Supply Chain Manager and help shape the future of our Supply Chain function as we expand across the Supply Chain / Logistics / Import-Export sector.
topReasonsToJoin: Annual company trip and quarterly team-building activities
Sponsored sport clubs, happy hour and wellness activities
13th month salary plus performance-based bonus
responsibilities: Own the overall strategy for core supply chain activities aligned with company goals and standards.
Lead, manage, and grow collaboration with cross-functional departments, ensuring consistency and accuracy across all deliverables.
Lead, manage, and grow reporting and performance tracking and provide regular updates to relevant stakeholders.
Lead, manage, and grow continuous improvement initiatives to support smooth execution and timely delivery.
Lead, manage, and grow day-to-day operations related to the role, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.
Lead, manage, and grow a team of professionals, setting clear goals and supporting their development.
requirements: 6+ years of experience, including 2-3 years in a management role relevant to the Supply Chain Manager role.
Solid understanding of industry best practices and relevant tools or systems.
Ability to work independently and under pressure
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
Strong time-management and prioritization skills
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.

benefits.label: Opportunity to work with international partners
Holiday and Tet bonus
Flexible working hours and hybrid option
16-18 days of paid annual leave
Premium healthcare package for employee and dependents
Recognition programs and quarterly awards
